.production-finance{padding-top:30px;padding-bottom:110px}.finance-filters{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 2fr;gap:12px;margin:25px 0}.finance-filters label{font-size:11px;color:#aaa}.finance-filters input,.finance-filters select{display:block;width:100%;min-width:0;margin-top:8px;padding:12px;border:1px solid #39343f;border-radius:10px;background:#151318;color:#eee}.finance-totals{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px;margin:22px 0}.finance-totals article{padding:22px;border:1px solid #504030;border-radius:17px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#43281944,#18151d)}.finance-totals small{display:block;color:#afa1ad;font-size:10px}.finance-totals b{display:block;margin-top:12px;font-size:clamp(18px,3vw,27px)}.finance-records>article{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;padding:22px;border:1px solid #ffffff12;border-radius:17px;background:#18151b;margin:12px 0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.finance-records h3{font-size:15px;margin:10px 0}.finance-records p,.finance-records small{color:#a297a6;font-size:11px;line-height:1.6}.finance-records summary{cursor:pointer;color:#c6ac9b;font-size:11px}.finance-record-values{min-width:140px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;align-items:flex-end}.finance-record-values b{font-size:23px;color:#ffb17c}.finance-record-values span{font-size:11px;color:#bbb}.finance-muted{font-size:11px;line-height:1.7;color:#a79aaa}.finance-unavailable{padding:25px;border:1px solid #765544;border-radius:17px;background:#49271322}.finance-unavailable h2{font-size:18px}.finance-unavailable p{font-size:12px;line-height:1.7;color:#bbaaaf}.finance-record-backdrop{z-index:260}.finance-record-modal{max-height:calc(100dvh - 30px);overflow:auto}.finance-record-modal h2{font-size:23px}.finance-record-modal>p{font-size:12px;line-height:1.6}.finance-record-total{padding:17px;background:#ff953415;border:1px solid #a765313d;border-radius:12px}.finance-record-total small{display:block;color:#c5b9c4;font-size:11px}.finance-record-total b{display:block;font-size:27px;margin-top:8px;color:#ffab70}.finance-record-modal input,.finance-record-modal textarea{width:100%;margin-top:7px;min-height:43px}.finance-record-modal .field{margin:14px 0}.finance-record-modal .modal-footer{flex-wrap:wrap}
@media(max-width:650px){.finance-filters{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.finance-filters label:last-child{grid-column:1/-1}.finance-totals{grid-template-columns:1fr}.finance-totals article{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:16px}.finance-totals b{margin:0}.finance-records>article{flex-direction:column}.finance-record-values{align-items:flex-start}.finance-record-modal{width:100%;max-height:calc(100dvh - 12px);padding:18px}.finance-record-backdrop{padding:6px}.finance-record-modal .modal-footer button{flex:1}}
